verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Qapita offers tools aimed at fractional CFOs managing multiple clients, legal teams handling client equity, and an investor portal. None of it documents delegated or scoped third-party access, role-limited permissions, or API credentials that would let authorized outside parties see only a slice of the company's equity data without admin rights. No public API spec was found either (OpenAPI probes all returned 404). These adjacent persona-targeted features do not establish the scoped-delegation capability the story asks for.
